correctness.serverCounterNodeIdentity: verified before activation and after each click
correctness.rowContent: all 100 rows and summary checked with JS disabled, after activation, and after each click
correctness.rowNodeIdentity: not measured; frozen protocol requires unchanged row content and retained counter nodes

definitions.htmlBytes: Decoded response body bytes, including hydration payload; not HTTP wire bytes.
definitions.transferredJavaScriptBytes: CDP encodedDataLength for Script resources including response overhead, through readiness + two verified clicks + 500 ms network idle; not pure bundle size.
definitions.readinessMs: Navigation-start performance.now() recorded by the framework initial-commit readiness hook; includes loading/parse/evaluation/scheduling and activation, not only adoption.
definitions.activationMs: Immediately before explicit native activation call through initial-commit hook; unavailable for Next/Astro and unlike native boundaries are not equivalent.
definitions.clickMs: Programmatic button.click() to observed output text, includes mutation-observer delivery when needed; not paint or physical-input latency.
definitions.spread: sample standard deviation (n-1); median/min/max retained. Click aggregate contains two observations per fresh context, not ten independent contexts.

limitations: Single campaign, no before/after source comparison or cross-runner gain claim.
